card.name: China-related text, partway through numbers and names
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points and name pieces inside passages about China, such as Chinese history, dates, statistics and romanized Chinese names. It is not the word China itself.

card.plain: It activates in China-themed text on numbers and name pieces, and pushes the model toward naming other countries instead of China.
